title: Maintenance window 2026-11-29
body: The delta API is read-only on 2026-11-29 between 01:00 and 03:00 UTC. Cursors issued before the window stay valid; clients should retry with backoff.

title: Schema v2.3: integrator action required - expired local price overrides
body: Schema v2.3 (feed epoch 2026.47) re-issues retired SKU codes within the epoch. Integrators must remove expired local price overrides (rows whose end date has passed) from their override tables before applying v2.3 deltas: expired rows are re-evaluated against re-issued codes during apply and cause effective-price drift. Remove them once per integration, e.g. DELETE FROM price_overrides WHERE ends_on < date('now'). Integrations that keep expired overrides are out of contract for MAP pricing from 2026-11-25 (Integrator Agreement s4.2).
